name: std::list<T,Allocator>::append_range

declarations.code:
template <container - compatible - range<T> R>

void append_range(R &&rg);

intro:
Inserts copies of elements from the range rg before end(), in non-reversing order.

No iterators or references are invalidated.

Each iterator in rg is dereferenced exactly once.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
rg

 -

 a container compatible range, that is, an input_range whose elements are convertible to T


 Type requirements


 -T must be EmplaceConstructible into list from *ranges::begin(rg).  Otherwise, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in size of rg. The number of calls to the constructor of T is exactly equal to the std::ranges::size(rg)).

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If an exception is thrown for any reason, this function has no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).
